title: Create a Culture of Higher Values
text: [Music] it's important to spend time in the company of other people that have the same interest that you do so you need to spend time with other people that want to evolve and that share the same higher values otherwise you just you can't you're just going to lose it so the reason you need to spend time with other people who who share the same higher and developmental values you do is so that you'll keep them alive in yourself you'll be able to relate through those values with other people in a creative context which you cannot do with other individuals who don't share those values and and and when you share time with people who have those values and you begin to act on those values put them into practice then together you begin to create a new culture because the culture of shared value so when you shared values are all about the evolution of Consciousness and culture then through the way you relate with each other that should be being enacted [Music] [Laughter] [Music] [Laughter] [Music]
